verdict.rationale: Motion's docs say it blocks calendar time for daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly recurring tasks, and that it reshuffles the whole day and week when meetings run long or emergencies arise. That roughly covers recurring blocks being moved rather than dropped. Meeting windows ('focused mornings', meeting-free Fridays) and daily meeting caps add adjacent protection for focus periods. missing for 10: an explicit focus-time or habit-defense feature, evidence that recurring blocks are specifically rescheduled (not dropped) when conflicts appear, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
